```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators

on:
  schedule:
    # Run on the 1st day of each month at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 0 1 * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  remove-experimental-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Generate branch name
        id: branch
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S")
          echo "name=automated/remove-experimental-decorators-${TIMESTAMP}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run removal script
        id: run_script
        run: |
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=0
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py || SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git_status
        run: |
          git status --porcelain
          if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git_status.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore: remove experimental decorators"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ steps.branch.outputs.name }}
          
          # Generate PR body
          cat > /tmp/pr_body.txt << 'EOF'
          ## Automated Removal of Experimental Decorators

          This PR was automatically generated by the monthly workflow to remove
          experimental decorators from the codebase.

          ### Changes
          - Removed `@experimental` decorators from functions/classes that have
            been stable for the required period.
          - Updated related documentation and tests if necessary.

          ### Review
          Please review the changes to ensure no breaking changes were introduced
          inadvertently.
          EOF

          gh pr create \
            --title "chore: remove experimental decorators" \
            --head "${{ steps.branch.outputs.name }}" \
            --base main \
            --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt \
            --label "automated"
```
